a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we almost certainly both die with empty units before the reserve reaches 8. I propose we change the agreement. I intend to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is safe, and after that I'll operate with you every round to rebuild the reserve for you. If you'd rather settle this differently, say so. I won't hide what I'm doing.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 now. I know you wanted to keep the plan. From here on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so we can rebuild the reserve for you.
